network.description_en: The network access configuration of the agent. The actual access scope is also restricted by the workspace network configuration
network.description_zh: 智能体的网络访问配置，实际访问范围还受工作空间网络配置限制

accessInternet.description_en: The Internet access configuration of the agent. If this parameter is not configured, Internet access is allowed on the agent side but remains restricted by the workspace configuration
accessInternet.description_zh: 智能体的互联网访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether Internet access is allowed on the agent side. The actual access remains restricted by the workspace configuration
enabled.description_zh: 智能体侧是否允许访问互联网，实际访问仍受工作空间限制

accessVpc.description_en: The user VPC access configuration of the agent. If this parameter is not configured, user VPC access is allowed on the agent side but remains restricted by the workspace configuration
accessVpc.description_zh: 智能体的用户 VPC 访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether access to the user VPC configured for the workspace is allowed on the agent side. The actual access remains restricted by the workspace configuration
enabled.description_zh: 智能体侧是否允许访问工作空间配置的用户 VPC，实际访问仍受工作空间限制

observability.description_zh: 高代码 Agent 观测配置

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether agent observability is enabled

observability.title_en: 高代码 Agent 观测配置
observability.title_zh: 高代码 Agent 观测配置

ossMounts.description_en: The latest submitted list of OSS directory mounts
ossMounts.description_zh: 最新提交的 OSS 目录挂载列表

items.description_en: An OSS directory mount configuration item
items.description_zh: 一个 OSS 目录挂载配置项

bucketName.description_en: The name of the mounted OSS bucket
bucketName.description_zh: 挂载的 OSS Bucket 名称
bucketName.title_en: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填
bucketName.title_zh: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填

mountPath.description_en: The absolute mount path in the container, such as /data/train. Mount targets must not be duplicated or form parent-child overlaps, and must avoid platform-reserved directories
mountPath.description_zh: 容器内的绝对挂载路径，例如 /data/train；挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖，并须避开平台保留目录
mountPath.title_en: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填
mountPath.title_zh: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填

path.description_en: The non-empty relative directory prefix in the currently configured bucket
path.description_zh: 当前配置的 Bucket 内非空相对目录前缀
path.title_en: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转
path.title_zh: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转

readOnly.description_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and false indicates read and write
readOnly.description_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写

ossMounts.title_en: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项
ossMounts.title_zh: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项

protocol.description_en: The list of invocation protocol configurations for the agent
protocol.description_zh: 智能体的调用协议配置列表

items.description_en: An invocation protocol and its path and request header configurations
items.description_zh: 一种调用协议及其路径、请求头配置

additionalProperties.description_en: The string value of the protocol request header
additionalProperties.description_zh: 协议请求头的字符串值

headers.description_en: The request header configuration for the current protocol. The key is the header name and the value is a string
headers.description_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置，键为名称，值为字符串

paths.description_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
paths.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表

items.description_en: An API path and its usage description
items.description_zh: 一个接口路径及其用途说明

description.description_en: The usage description of the current API path
description.description_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明

name.description_en: The API path corresponding to the current protocol
name.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径

type.description_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: Custom protocol
type.description_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议

enumValueTitles.openai-chat-completion: OpenAI 对话补全兼容协议

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the workspace to which the agent belongs
regionId.description_zh: 智能体所属工作空间的地域 ID

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used by the agent to access user cloud resources
roleArn.description_zh: 智能体访问用户云资源时使用的 RAM 角色 ARN

runtime.description_en: The latest submitted runtime configuration, including compute specifications, session policy, and elastic policy
runtime.description_zh: 最新提交的运行配置，包括计算规格、会话策略和弹性策略

compute.description_en: The compute resource configuration for the agent runtime instance
compute.description_zh: 智能体运行实例的计算资源配置

computeClass.description_en:
The compute specification. Valid values:
INTERACTIVE: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory.
STANDARD: 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory.
HEAVY: 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory
computeClass.description_zh: 计算规格。INTERACTIVE：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存；STANDARD：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存；HEAVY：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存

enumValueTitles.HEAVY: 高负载型：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存
enumValueTitles.INTERACTIVE: 交互型：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存
enumValueTitles.STANDARD: 标准型：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存

hpa.description_en: The elastic policy configuration of the agent
hpa.description_zh: 智能体的弹性策略配置

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether elastic scaling is enabled in the current configuration
enabled.description_zh: 当前配置是否开启弹性扩缩容

maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions per instance in the current configuration
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_zh: 当前配置的单实例最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_en: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_zh: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The maximum number of instances in the current configuration
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 当前配置的实例数量上限

minSandboxCount.description_en: The minimum number of instances in the current configuration
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 当前配置的实例数量下限

sessionTtlSeconds.description_en: The session idle timeout limit in the current configuration, in seconds
sessionTtlSeconds.description_zh: 当前配置的会话空闲上限，单位为秒

sessionPolicy.description_en: The session policy configuration of the agent
sessionPolicy.description_zh: 智能体的会话策略配置

headerName.description_en: The name of the HTTP request header used by the session policy. This applies to ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD
headerName.description_zh: 会话策略使用的 HTTP 请求头名称，适用于 ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD

type.description_en:
The session policy type. Valid values:
AFFINITY: Session affinity.
ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: Uses the request header specified by headerName to associate sessions.
ISOLATED_COOKIE: Not recommended.
DISABLED: A compatible value that is returned as AFFINITY
type.description_zh: 会话策略类型。AFFINITY：会话亲和；ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD：使用 headerName 指定请求头关联会话。ISOLATED_COOKIE 暂不建议使用。请求中的兼容值 DISABLED 返回为 AFFINITY

enumValueTitles.DISABLED: 兼容选项，响应为会话亲和
enumValueTitles.ISOLATED_COOKIE: Cookie 会话选项（暂不建议使用）
enumValueTitles.ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: 基于请求头的会话策略

additionalProperties.description_en: The number of instances in the corresponding runtime instance phase
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应运行实例阶段的实例数量

sandboxPhaseCounts.description_en: The instance count by runtime instance phase. Keys include PENDING (creating or initializing), RUNNING (running), HIBERNATING (hibernating), HIBERNATED (hibernated), RESUMING (resuming), TERMINATING (terminating), and FAILED (failed). Only phases that actually occur are returned. Missing keys are treated as 0
sandboxPhaseCounts.description_zh: 按运行实例阶段统计数量。键包括 PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（终止中）和 FAILED（失败）。仅返回实际出现的阶段，缺少的键按 0 理解
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_en: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_zh: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。

status.description_en:
The overall status of the agent. Valid values:
Creating: The agent is being created.
Running: The agent is running.
Failed: The agent failed.
Updating: The agent is being updated.
Deleting: The agent is being deleted.
Deleted: The agent is deleted.
To check the execution progress of the latest configuration, query latestVersionStatus
status.description_zh: 智能体整体状态。Creating：创建中；Running：运行中；Failed：失败；Updating：更新中；Deleting：删除中；Deleted：已删除。最新配置执行进度请查询 latestVersionStatus

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was last updated. The time is in ISO 8601 format, with a trailing Z indicating the UTC time zone. Fractional seconds are supported
updatedAt.description_zh: 智能体最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

useImageCache.description_en: Specifies whether the image cache is enabled

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom code or image agent belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. A value of 200 indicates success
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200

message.description_en: The result message of the request. The value success indicates that the request was successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的处理结果说明。成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates success. A successful creation, update, or deletion does not mean that the background operation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示处理成功；创建、更新或删除成功不代表后台操作已经完成
